events.body:
The production environment for ForkMesh v0.7.0 was reported to be a mess by World Guest 6650, but jett confirmed it has been cleaned up. However, the initial report and subsequent confirmation of cleanup suggest there may have been issues with the multiplayer validation process that need to be formally documented and reviewed to prevent future occurrences.
